name: Snowfield Patrol
description: Brave the frozen expanse of Rioh. The cold isn't the only thing that bites out here.

dialog.speaker: Hunter
dialog.text: Came out here looking for game, but nothing out here is safe to eat. The meat's got a weird color to it.

dialog.speaker: Hunter
dialog.text: Whatever's wrong with the soil, it's in the animals too. Whole trip's been a waste.
